theme: royal chronicler batching decrees before sealing wax
title: Royal Chronicle: Batching Decrees and Ordering the Wax Page for Fire-Drill Recovery
strategies: seal every decree alone the instant it arrives, in id order (trivial baseline)
textbook deadline-driven group commit: batch pending decrees, flush the whole queue the moment the earliest deadline is reached, records in plain arrival order (greedy)

same batch schedule, but reorder each sealed page by descending fire-drill relevance (how many known crash points need each decree) so recovery resolves needed keys in a handful of probes instead of scanning the whole page (strong)
fully joint optimization of seal timing AND in-page order against the whole crash-point set at once (open ceiling, uncovered)
